Limitations: Single-author constructive essay/book; programmatic argument with normative agenda; selective engagement with Chinese intellectual history (read through Heidegger/Needham/Simondon/Stiegler); archive.org scan is a rights-caution copy (shared non-lending collection item; uploader rights unverified) - prefer publisher/licensed text for formal quoting; edition/page-number variance between scan and print; 'cosmotechnic pluralism' is a thesis, not an established descriptive fact.
Disconfirming Implication: If technics are ultimately universalizable (functional convergence), cosmotechnic pluralism overstates divergence; if 'cosmotechnics' itself operates with Western categories, the critique of dependency is incomplete (an internal challenge Hui anticipates); historical technology shows massive cross-cultural borrowing, complicating civilizational distinctness claims.
Design Implication: Governing telos (layer 2.13) - the plan's horizon: the tool must be grounded in a cosmos-ethic-technics unity, not output maximization; any artifact claim must be checkable against the cosmotechnic criterion.
Cosmotechnic Implication: Sets the whole cosmotechnic criterion; anti-veneer standard - 'cosmotechnics' must remain structural, never decorative. (No revision: correct and meta-level.)

Key Finding / Thesis: Third and final volume of the Recursivity & Contingency series (after Art and Cosmotechnics 2021); a 'Tractatus Politico-Technologicus': political philosophy can no longer avoid technology; introduces 'political epistemology' as the method (following Mumford's megamachine - political epistemology legitimates and guides it); engages Hegel's nation-state and Schmitt's Grossraum as the two modern political forms a future planetary thinking must surpass; core agenda: technodiversity (biodiversity-no
Effect Size / Strength: not_quantifiable (philosophical). Strength = high as the v6 scaffold/anti-veneer standard (construct-role claim).
Limitations: Programmatic and speculative; architectonic rather than empirically demonstrated; dense Hegel/Schmitt exegesis; single-author; open-access UMN 2024 edition verified (local copy /opt/data/machine and sovereignty yuk hui.pdf, 352p; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0); audit criteria (technodiversity, organology/proportion, prosthesis vs replacement) require operationalization before use in the Cosmotechnic Audit Card - unoperationalized they risk category error (normative heuristic treated as measurable construct).
Disconfirming Implication: If nation-state and Grossraum are not the binding constraints on contemporary digital power (platform/network sovereignty differs from territorial), the planetary framing may miss emergent forms; if technodiversity is read as valorizing any difference (relativism), the anti-localism guard weakens; acceleration/automation may outpace organological critique; if planetary thinking remains a European project in disguise, its universality claim is strained.
Design Implication: Govern cosmotechnic criteria: technodiversity, organology/proportion, prosthesis vs replacement, locality/localism - Cosmotechnic Audit Card / Design Memo v6; operationalize each criterion before use.
Cosmotechnic Implication: Primary v6 cosmotechnic scaffold and anti-veneer standard; the tool must remain a locality capable of revision, not a localism hardened into identity (S10). (No revision: matches the source agenda cleanly.)
